verdict.rationale: Rootly Workflows are documented as its automation engine. Users define trigger events, run conditions and actions, choosing from 152 action types across Slack, Jira, on-call, AI and incident operations, with Liquid templating for dynamic values. Condition-based Alert Routes and AI SRE investigation rules add further rule-driven automation on incoming events. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that workflow rules perform as documented, and an enumerated list of the available trigger events.
